title: Hearty Roasted Brazilian Swede Roast
description: A crumbly and flavorful Brazilian dish featuring roasted swede and ferment kimchi, perfect for a midnight craving. This kosher friendly recipe is served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the cubed swede with olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the swede mixture on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the swede in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until it is tender and lightly browned.
While the swede is roasting, heat the ferment kimchi in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once the swede is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
To serve, place the roasted swede on a wooden board, top it with the heated ferment kimchi, and garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
